Dansk Selskab for Klinisk Ernæring is a professional organization that plays a central role in the systematic quality development of Danish acute surgery. Within the framework of the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB), the organization serves as a key partner in advancing evidence-based clinical nutrition practices and shaping national healthcare standards [^src1].

In the context of the 2025 AKDB annual report, which evaluates central quality indicators including early mobilization (Indikator 6), nutrition (Indikator 7), and epidural use (Indikator 8), Dansk Selskab for Klinisk Ernæring is specifically engaged to address the evaluation and development of nutrition metrics [^src1]. To tackle ongoing challenges and a lack of analysis related to the existing nutrition indicator, [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] established a dedicated working group in collaboration with Dansk Selskab for Klinisk Ernæring [^src1]. This working group is tasked with developing a new, clinically relevant outcome quality indicator for nutrition, an effort directly tied to the broader institutional mechanisms surrounding [[indikator-7|Indikator 7]] [^src1].

The direct collaboration between the national steering committee and Dansk Selskab for Klinisk Ernæring underscores the organization's authority in clinical nutrition practice and its critical function in evidence-based development for acute surgical care [^src1].
